tbesh_html:
1) to be grieved, loathe, abhor, feel a loathing or abhorrence or sickening dread
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to feel a loathing at, abhor
1a2) to feel a sickening dread
1b) (Hiphil)
1b1) to cause sickening dread
1b2) to cause loathing

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to be (causatively, make) disgusted or anxious
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (identical with through the idea of severing oneself from (compare H6962 (קוּט)));
strongs_1890.kjv_def: abhor, be distressed, be grieved, loathe, vex, be weary.
